message: 熱き情熱の果てに

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, the problem's safely solved, then. Congrats」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, actually, that's not quite the case」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Demon's body is burning hotter day by day, his blood boiling and flesh dancing wild and free, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's that supposed to mean」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If we don't relieve all that pent-up frustration for him, someone else somewhere will fall prey to his wicked fangs again~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「D-Don't put so much emotion into it\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「In short, if we don't prevent a relapse, it won't really be solved」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You two sure are soft-hearted」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Helping those in trouble is only natural. Right, Azel?♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Waaah! Say something if you're there, Ma!」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's the situation. Any good ideas?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If he wants cold water, why not just chuck him into a fountain or something?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That ought to do the trick~」
How did they even manage to hurl a body hot enough to burn on contact?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now then, let's see how this goes」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if he'll be okay......」
He sank for a brief second, then immediately floated back up.
He has a look of pure bliss on his face. Just as we thought it was a success--

name: Lolotte
message: 「P-P-President! For some reason, bubbles are」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A fart?」

name: Synn
message: 「Pavel!」
As we watched with bated breath, the bubbles gradually multiplied.

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way」
When I dipped my hand into the water--

name: Synn
message: 「It's lukewarm!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it boiling?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We gotta pull it up fast. Don't we have a net or a fishing rod or something!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, hello~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now is not the time to be leisurely chatting on the phone!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Jiiya? Yes, right behind me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Behind Lolotte?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa!!」
A fishing rod fell down from the sky.

name: Synn
message: 「With this rod... Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Leave it to me!」
She deftly hooked the lure onto its body--FISH ON!

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a catch~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All right! The fish aren't floating up」
How tough can it get.

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, what should we do」

name: Nanaka
message: 「At this point, we have no choice but to throw it into the sea!」

name: Synn
message: 「If that causes the sea level to rise, we'll be in big trouble!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then what are we supposed to do?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Looks like they're in a good mood, though~. Mr. Demon」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, after burning off that many calories, I guess so」

name: Shio
message: 「Judgment!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, please stop!」

name: Shio
message: 「Fiend of evil, I shall cut you down!」
Shio-chan attacked the Demon without a second thought. Lolotte threw herself in the way to protect them.

name: Synn
message: 「Watch out, Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeek, kyaah! Mr. President...!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, don't. If you touch it, you'll get burned and it'll leave a scar」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, you mustn't grab me so hard like that~」
Wha--this softness... I just grabbed somewhere completely outrageous.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stop that, you huge pervert!」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh... That hurts」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Serves you right」

name: Shio
message: 「C-Could it be... that the Student Council has defected to the enemy!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've got it wrong, Shio-chan. This demon is... uh, an ally?」

name: Shio
message: 「You jest!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no jesting or anything about it. Um, you see, there's a deep reason behind this--」
Leaving Shio-chan to Nanaka for now.

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... sorry, Lolotte. I just got totally carried away in the heat of the moment...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's quite alright. After all, you were protecting me, President」
Aah, Lolotte is so kind... Savoring the faint sensation lingering on my palm--no, bad, bad!

name: Nanaka
message: 「--And so, that's the gist of it」

name: Shio
message: 「I see... So it was merely a hasty assumption on my part. Dear me, how embarrassing」

name: Shio
message: 「After going through the trouble of bathing, sweating now would truly render all that effort for naught」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, the scent of shampoo」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmh~ It smells lovely~♪」

name: Shio
message: 「H-How shameless\s03」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Agh, jeez. Having this guy around makes it so ridiculously hot. Maybe I'll take a shower before heading home too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right. Why don't you use it instead of taking a bath at home? Like a Student Council President privilege or whatever」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooooh, I didn't think of that! Wait, isn't that kind of cheating though?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You ran for office specifically for perks like that, so what are you even saying now?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President. By shower, do you mean the ones over by the indoor pool?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's true, but...

name: Synn
message: Oh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What about the water over there?」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... Lolotte! That might actually work」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've got a good idea. Let's head to the pool」
Club activities have ended, leaving the pool quiet and deserted.
After getting permission from the caretaker, we try out a certain experiment.

name: Synn
message: 「I see. So a boiler heats it up, and it gets used for the showers and the pool」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Right here」

name: Synn
message: 「Heating up this much water takes a massive amount of fuel. But with this guy around...」
I try dropping it into the pool.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, the results speak for themselves」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And presto, we've got a hot spring!」
The one actually soaking in it wears a generally satisfied expression.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. All it needs is moisture--the water doesn't have to be cold. That makes things simple」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So we're going to market this place as a hot spring?!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I was just testing whether the used wastewater would satisfy the Demon's urges」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a shame...」
I fish the Demon back out and face it once more.

name: Synn
message: 「Starting today, I want you to take the place of the boiler」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Bo-i-ler?」

name: Synn
message: 「I want you to make the hot water here」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Judging by your constitution, it looks like you raise temperatures through heat conduction rather than combustion」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, if it were actually burning, the whole place would be up in flames by now」

name: Synn
message: 「We use this heat transfer to warm up the cold water stored inside the boiler, and that becomes the hot water for the showers and the pool」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~」

name: Synn
message: 「When heating up the cold water, the heat should cool down a bit. Even though it's indirect, the volume being heated is on a whole different scale」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But then he wouldn't get the 'moisture' you mentioned earlier, Mr. President」

name: Synn
message: 「True. Since it seems like he loves getting doused in water」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aah!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So this pool becomes Mr. Demon's bath!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Exactly! The true reward comes after all the work is done. When we change the water, he can replenish his moisture in the pool to his heart's content」

name: Synn
message: 「...That's what I came up with, anyway. W-What do you think?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You really are the king of cheapskates. No, sorry. Today I mean that as a compliment」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... She called you a king」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're amazing, Mr. President. You truly possess ideas that go beyond mere delusion」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're exaggerating」

name: Helena
message: 「Do you even know how a boiler is structured?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Helena
message: 「As for whether the boiler's outer shell can withstand that intense heat, the answer is NO」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way...」

name: Helena
message: 「Unfortunately, your ideal is impossible to achieve at the current stage」
Is this the limit of a mere student's shallow thinking.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, it'd make the money spent on fuel completely free, right? I think it's a wonderful, lucrative deal, though...」

name: Helena
message: 「True. Assuming we deduct the monthly fuel costs--」

name: Helena
message: 「Even with an upfront investment in heat-resistant construction, we could still keep expenses well down」

name: Synn
message: 「So that means--」

name: Helena
message: 「It means it's worth a try」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We did it, Presideeeent!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoaaa!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good for you two」

name: Helena
message: 「In practice, I'll be doing things in a slightly more rational way, if you don't mind?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, well, that was just an armchair theory anyway... I'll leave it to the expert」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll have you keep working the way you have been. Will that be alright?」

name: Ippuu
message: 「Eee!」

name: Helena
message: 「Then we have a deal. As an employee of the academy, I look forward to working with you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To think we could join hands and help each other out with a Demon... I never would have dreamed it」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh? You might be surprised--we could already be helping each other out in places you don't know about」

name: Helena
message: 「Here you go, Synn-chan. Since you worked so hard, a special present」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san...」

name: Helena
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... every once in a while, something besides a trophy... you know...」

name: Helena
message: 「Once you work a little harder, okay?\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Ohhh, I'll give it my allll!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You can do it, Presideeeent♪」

name: Azel
message: 「Helping each other with Demons?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's pointless」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes... completely pointless」
